summary: Brian Fitzpatrick, 51, of Colorado Springs, drowned after a commercial raft flipped in Rapid #5 on the Numbers section of the Arkansas River north of Buena Vista; a downstream commercial guide pulled him from the river and began CPR; AHRA rangers, Chaffee County Sheriff's deputies and Chaffee County EMS responded but could not revive him; autopsy established drowning.
location: Rapid #5, Numbers section, Arkansas River north of Buena Vista
responding_agency: CPW Arkansas Headwaters Recreation Area rangers; Chaffee County Sheriff's Office; Chaffee County EMS
notes: American Whitewater accident record (Ark Valley Voice / KDVR accounts). Run 1017 chunk A.
